summary: Collect diagnostics for support with oc adm must-gather --image=registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/aap-must-gather-rhel9, then browse the tarball with omc use <path> and omc get pods.
questions: How do I run must-gather for AAP 2.6?
Which must-gather image does AAP 2.6 use?
How do I read a must-gather with omc?

answer_card.title: must-gather for AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc adm must-gather --image=registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/aap-must-gather-rhel9
omc use <path-to-must-gather>
omc get pods
```
